title: 小学
description: 适合 5-12 岁、已有少量英语基础的孩子。从数字积木、字母积木的自然拼读与故事启蒙，到科普纪录片、新闻短报与观点表达，语速和词汇难度逐集递进。
descriptionEn: For children aged 5-12 with some English foundation. From phonics and simple storytelling (Numberblocks, Alphablocks) to science documentaries, news briefs and opinion expression (TED-Ed, Newsround, BBC Earth). Difficulty increases progressively.

items.description: 数字 1 登场。全篇围绕 one 反复出现，句子极短，适合建立最初的数量词和语感。
items.descriptionEn: The number One arrives. Very short lines built around the word 'one' — a gentle start for counting vocabulary.

items.description: 认识数字 2。出现 two、pair、together 等数量与配对表达，比第 1 集句子更长。
items.descriptionEn: Meet the number Two. Introduces two, pair and together — longer sentences than episode one.

items.description: 字母 b 和 ee 组合成 bee。自然拼读启蒙，单词拼读过程会被念出来。
items.descriptionEn: Letters b and ee blend into 'bee'. Phonics primer — the blending is spoken out loud.

items.description: BBC 经典英语教学动画。句型刻意重复、语速慢，专为外语学习者设计。
items.descriptionEn: The BBC's classic English-teaching animation. Deliberate repetition and slow speech, designed for learners.

items.englishName: Go Jetters: The Great Wall of China
items.description: 到中国长城探险。地理名词与方位表达，篇幅短、适合做听力入门。
items.descriptionEn: A trip to the Great Wall of China. Geography nouns and directional language — very short, good for listening practice.

items.chineseName: TED 教育：植物怎么知道时间
items.description: 植物如何感知昼夜与季节。科普说明文结构，出现 circadian、season 等学科词。
items.descriptionEn: How plants sense day, night and the seasons. Expository science writing with terms like circadian and season.

items.description: 讲肠道怎么工作。主持人对话体，语速偏快，含 stomach、digest 等身体与生理词。
items.descriptionEn: How the guts work. Presenter-led conversation at a brisk pace, with body and digestion vocabulary.

items.englishName: Newsround: What's it like living with flooding
items.chineseName: 新闻轮：住在洪水区是什么体验
items.description: BBC 儿童新闻，孩子讲述洪水经历。新闻英语的时态与引述结构，情感表达真实。
items.descriptionEn: BBC children's news — kids describe living with flooding. News-style tenses and reported speech, with genuine emotion.

items.description: 用歌曲讲黑死病。歌词押韵、节奏快，历史词与口语混在一起，难度不低但好记。
items.descriptionEn: The Black Death as a song. Rhyming, fast-paced lyrics mixing history terms with colloquial English — tricky but memorable.

items.englishName: Deadly 60: Angry Hippos vs Steve Backshall
items.description: 主持人近距离拍河马。野外实拍，现场解说多，含 danger、territory 等词。
items.descriptionEn: Steve Backshall gets close to hippos. Real wildlife footage with live commentary — danger, territory and related words.

items.englishName: BBC Earth Kids: Penguins Go MONTHS Without Feeding
items.chineseName: BBC 地球儿童：企鹅数月不进食
items.description: 帝企鹅孵蛋期间数月不进食。自然纪录片解说体，长句多，适合练段落理解。
items.descriptionEn: Emperor penguins go months without feeding while incubating. Documentary narration with long sentences — good for passage comprehension.

items.englishName: TED-Ed: The Surprising Reason Our Muscles Get Tired
items.chineseName: TED 教育：肌肉为什么会累
items.description: 肌肉疲劳的真正原因。因果解释结构（because、so、that's why），学科词较多。
items.descriptionEn: The real reason muscles get tired. Cause-and-effect structure (because, so, that's why) with academic vocabulary.
